end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste, explaining compost pits, shared responsibility for school cleanliness, and ways to save water and keep the school safe and green. They used examples such as peels, rice, tea leaves, plastic, paper, roof-water collection, and fixing leaking taps. The plastic-in-compost mix-up was revisited, but it was not confirmed corrected at the end. At home, ask Anika to sort five household items and explain which bin each belongs in and why.
